changes_made.explanation: Removed MS MARCO (retrieval dataset, not NLG), removed retrieval models (RetroMAE, Contriever) as they are not NLG models, normalized model names, simplified output descriptions
Normalized 'exact match' to 'EM' as they refer to the same metric

Removed all items since LLMs are used for annotation/training, not as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. The paper uses LLMs to annotate document utility for training retrievers, not to evaluate generated text quality.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted in this paper

overall_notes: The paper focuses on using LLMs for document utility annotation to train retrieval and RAG systems, rather than evaluating NLG outputs. While it does involve NLG (question answering via RAG), the primary contribution is in retrieval system training. The automatic metrics are used to evaluate RAG performance, but no LLM-as-judge or human evaluation of generated text is performed.
